arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND p2.XCL_044 IS NOT NULL
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_1" > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT("__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0") AS percentage FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_026 AS "__grain_value_0", p.XCL_031 AS "__grain_value_1" FROM users AS u JOIN badges AS b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002 JOIN posts AS p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033 WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p2 WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND NOT p2.XCL_044 IS NULL)) AS __ontology_entity_grain
